steps.name: A Certain Gift (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Narin] in 「Gerda」, then defeat [Argos] in 「Icicle Prison」 to obtain the <Ice Necklace>. Then report to [Narin] in 「Gerda」.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What a quandary. What should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin, is something troubling you? Your sighs are melting all the ice nearby.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Ah, you've arrived?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh, if I keep this up, Gerda will grow unsettled too. I must collect myself.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Narin, Narin, Nariring!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin, what manner of incantation is that? I mean, what is it? Huh?
(After finishing the strange chant, Narin stretches. A cool, refreshing wind blows across Gerda's sky.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Long ago, when I first met Io, she taught me that spell to lift my spirits.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: At first, I wondered what sort of child she was. But as I kept using it, it began to work naturally.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It does not increase elemental damage, penetration, or movement speed, mind you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What do you...?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Merely a jest. Hehe. I, Narin, have a favor to ask. Would you hear it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me what it is first.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: With Io absent, this seems the perfect time to speak.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io's father, Inachus, and Argos were close friends. Whenever anything happened in the village, they would discuss it together.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Argos was especially devoted to Gerda. He always insisted they call on him whenever strength was needed.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: So Inachus used his skill to make ice sculptures and ornaments as gifts for Argos.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: He even made the ring with which he proposed to Melia himself.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: As I recall, shortly before that incident, he was making something for Io as well.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I wish to find it. If a memory of it remains on the "Reverse Side" your footsteps can reach, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You care about Io deeply, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe. She is the child who taught me such nonsense as "Narin, Narin, Nariring," after all. Since I am asking the favor, I shall certainly reward you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: A coupon for an adventurer trusted by the spirits! The goddess herself certifies it, so you may be assured of its worth.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A coupon! Those really were useful. Hmm, then I'll visit the prison where Argos was.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I wish I could accompany you, but even a spirit like me cannot reach that realm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Narin. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Please travel safely.

steps.name: A Certain Gift (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Echo] in 「Echo Spring」 and obtain the <Ice Mirror>. Then report to [Narin] in 「Gerda」.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: You've returned, %s. Fortunately, Io has not yet... What is that in your hand...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found this in the room where Argos was.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: A necklace of pure ice...
(Narin accepts the necklace from %s and examines it.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: This was made from the finest ice Deborah held. But it appears to be melting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Melting?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I shall try to freeze it again.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh dear... My power has no effect...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Could Echo have...?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: That wretched creature must have done something to this necklace.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'll need Echo's power to undo it.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Yes. Though I wonder whether anything bearing Echo's power remains at the spring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and look. Wait here. I'll hurry back before Io arrives.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Oh, already gone... Such decisiveness.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Sigh. I wanted to finish before Io returned...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Those snow-laden clouds riding the wind... She must have finished her work...

steps.name: A Certain Gift (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Narin] in 「Gerda」, then find [Io] and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Adventurer... you've returned?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if it belonged to Echo, but I found something suspicious and brought it back. Oh, Io...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I heard. You went back to that sinister place because Narin asked...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: The first time was at your request, was it not?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, right. Sorry we're such a troublesome human and spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I promised a spirit's coupon of trust as a reward.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: A coupon from a spirit for good deeds...? Still, if a Spirit King gives it, it must work, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Better than I expected.
(Narin spreads out a scroll and sets the ice necklace and ice mirror upon it.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You've learned how to use the scroll?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Somehow, I keep finding new applications for it.
(Narin extends a hand. The ice mirror cracks and splits into several pieces.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There's no tainted energy in this mirror. Does that mean the necklace won't melt now?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Yes. Use these ice fragments to freeze the necklace yourself.
(Narin brings Io's hands together and places the necklace and ice fragments within them.)
(Narin nods, and Io nods in return. A small blizzard rises around Io and flows into her hands.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I think it's done...
(Io gently shakes the necklace in her hands. It shines with a purity and clarity greater than when it was first found.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's beautiful...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Made from the purest ice in the Deborah Snowfields.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...Never mind that. What's written here? It's too small to read.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: No wonder your eyesight suffers when you shut yourself away researching. Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, what's wrong? What does it say to make you look like that?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: May I read it aloud?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm all right. Don't worry...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: 「To my daughter Ionis, who resembles the northern sea of Ionia...」

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Father...?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Only a spirit could have helped form a crystal this pure. At the time, I could do nothing...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: He must have spoken of you while helping Echo. But Echo...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, please give us a moment. Io will call for you shortly. Come to her mansion when she does.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll see you in a little while...
(Io bows her head, unable to speak. Narin approaches and gently embraces her.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Seeing you like this, I struggle to find words. But there is something I can do for you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I cannot wrap you in human warmth, but at least I can stay beside you...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io... Just for this moment, set your burdens down.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...Thank you, Narin...
(Droplets begin falling from Gerda's sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rain...?
(The clouds that brought the blizzard release a gentle rain. Beneath their ash-gray cover, white Gerda takes on shades of gray.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels so lonely... As though the sky is crying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will Io be all right? Oh, over there...
(%s spots Io beckoning from the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go over.
(The moment Io sees %s, she looks apologetic.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: First sending you away, then calling you back... I'm sorry to be so changeable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right. Are you, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm fine. Sometimes I'm not, but I'll always be all right in the end. Look, I'm fine now.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, your eyes are as swollen as packed snowballs. So very swollen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, keep that up and I'll freeze you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: You think I would stand idly by? I'll summon ice from somewhere and...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Sigh... All right. Let's stop. Anyway... Thank you, %s!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Because of Narin and me, you haven't even had a chance to visit your goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Iris would say the same.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...She would. For just a moment, I thought I heard her say, "Io, I'm all right."

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Really. I've been hearing the goddess's voice longer than you have, %s.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, are you showing off your age?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Ignore Narin. I'd like to see you in Gerda often. If you have any trouble, tell me right away.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: All right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I've spoken to Galette. Whenever you come to Gerda, make yourself at home at Snowflower. I'll cover it for the rest of your life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...The rest of my life?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes. I promise. Why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. You're very kind to me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, is that all...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll go rest for a while, then. See you later.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Get plenty of rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? I feel like I've forgotten something. What is it...?)
(Io and Narin wave to %s as the adventurer heads toward Snowflower.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I heard the broad story, but that spirit stamp you use on the coupons... Why did it start with Medea and end up in your hands?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hmm... I don't know either. Though we can certainly wonder...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Sigh. I suppose we should. I've been so distracted by Echo that I haven't paid enough attention. I'd better get moving tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: But, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Did you give %s the stamped coupon?
